svg.title: Wall overhead against main current
svg.desc: Per-minute overhead watts against main-output current, shaded by chassis fan speed, with the model at full fan speed and with the fan term removed, and the residual panel below.
svg.text: Wall (both cords, floors removed) minus the supply's main DC output, per minute; shade = fan speed; lines = the fitted model

path.title: model at full fan speed: supply + control + fans
model with the fan term removed: supply loss + control + cords
